subject: Life Skills
title: Active Listening
description: A quick win: understand Active Listening.

hook.text: Most people do not listen to understand. They listen to reply. The difference shows up instantly in conversation.

buildup.text: Active listening means giving full attention: no phone, no mental rehearsal of your response. Just presence.

discovery.text: Paraphrase what they said: 'So you are saying the project stalled because the brief was unclear?' Accuracy proves you.

twist.text: Silence after someone finishes is not awkward — it is generous.

climax.text: Ask follow-up questions that dig deeper. 'How did that make you feel?' beats 'That reminds me of my story.'

punchline.text: Listen to understand, not to respond. They will notice.

quiz.question: What is the simplest way to prove you are actively listening?
options: Paraphrasing what the speaker said accurately
